title: Pairs of Linear Equations
summary: Solving by graphs, substitution and elimination; consistency; and word problems.

cbse.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

objectives: I can solve a pair of equations by substitution and elimination.
I can tell from the coefficients whether there are one, none or infinitely many solutions.
I can form and solve equations from word problems.
misconceptions: Every pair of equations has exactly one solution.
You must always eliminate x first.
Parallel lines have one solution at infinity.
